purpose: The one practical canonical new-work queue consolidating waves 01–08 rather than 8 independent acquisition owners. Read-only source references to separate museum objects; original image files remain solely in canonical art archive once acquired.

policy.rating: 0–2 artworks excluded, 3 can be revisited, existing acquired 4–5 never re-source, 5 needed repeated use; past unnumbered subject selection ≠ 5.
policy.objectIdentity: Museum/owner plus accession+title, never subject name alone; source URL shared by distinct works is fine, but repeated URL within one institutional listing does NOT count proof of a unique object without name accession corroboration.
policy.provenance: Only verified original autograph oil painting rows are candidates for acquisition; works 'after', studio and prints held separately.
policy.artistCorpusCompletion: No claim of full Rubens / Van Dyck global oeuvre; Louvre Van Dyck holdings specifically audited; Prado Apostle series complete.
policy.rights: Digital reproduction worldwide commercial rights, pixel dimensions, fidelity and crop must be checked after artwork identity. Public-domain object alone does not clear copyrighted image.
